note: Package 34: the default content of the Parameters block and the AC grid (UI data, not rules). A layout item of the classic profile may carry its own "cells" (rows of number ids) for the Parameters block; numbers = the sheet numbers of wp/model/sources.py. ac_grid = the 3x3 AC zones (cell ids of RULES/ac_zones.md; 5 = you). levels = the number hierarchy (UI_WISHES point 11): large / medium / small object names of the labels. Package 34 part 2: tabs = the tab bar of the right column (a layout item may carry its own "tabs"); only "combat" has content now; quick = the quick grid size limits (UI_WISHES 9: default 8, 4-16). Package 35 P2: bottom_strip = the cells of the bottom strip (UI_WISHES 10; morale only in combat); second_strip = the cells "+ strip" adds (profile field strips); implemented_tabs gain journal and settings.
